user.title: Set up Daylight
user.description: Create a fixed-atmosphere daylight reference using Home Assistant's location. Includes illuminance, melanopic EDI, color temperature, normalized level, and geometric solar elevation. This integration does not control lights.

init.title: Configure receiving surface
init.description: Set the angle and direction of the surface receiving daylight. The fixed-atmosphere directional model includes direct sun, diffuse sky, and ground light; a horizontal surface is its 0° case.

data_description.facing_mode: Fixed bearing or turn to follow the sun’s current azimuth.
data_description.bearing: Degrees clockwise from north (east 90°, south 180°, west 270°). Ignored when following the sun.

review.title: Review daily daylight curve
review.description:
Predicted values for {date} at Home Assistant’s location. The three panels show illuminance, melanopic EDI, and color temperature across the local day. Values between simulated directions are interpolated clear-sky estimates. No setting changes until you save.

![Daily daylight preview]({preview_url})

from_elevation.name: Calculate from solar elevation
from_elevation.description: Return reference lux, melanopic EDI, and CCT for a geometric solar elevation. No state is changed. Capture the response data.

geometric_elevation.name: Geometric solar elevation
geometric_elevation.description: Degrees above the horizon, without atmospheric refraction.

from_level.name: Calculate from daylight level
from_level.description: Return reference lux, melanopic EDI, and CCT for a normalized daylight level. No state is changed. Capture the response data.

daylight_level.name: Daylight level
daylight_level.description: 0 is the dark reference; 1 is today's solar noon.

noon_elevation.name: Noon elevation
noon_elevation.description: Optional geometric noon elevation. Defaults to today's value at Home Assistant's location.
